name: WEBLINX
description: WEBLINX is a large-scale benchmark for conversational web navigation, featuring 100K interactions across 2300 expert demonstrations on over 150 real-world websites. It measures an agent's ability to follow multi-turn dialogue instructions to navigate websites and solve real-world tasks.
reputation: A widely used benchmark for conversational web navigation and one of the standard datasets for evaluating web agents on real websites.
notes: Focuses on real-world websites and multi-turn dialogue navigation; highlights challenges in generalization to unseen websites.
